title: sidalcea neomexicana subsp. crenulata
intro: Sidalcea neomexicana subsp. crenulata, commonly known as New Mexico checkerbloom, is a perennial plant species belonging to the mallow family (Malvaceae). This plant is used for its medicinal properties, which include its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Sidalcea neomexicana subsp. crenulata include its ability to soothe skin irritations and wounds due to its soothing and anti-inflammatory properties, while its antimicrobial properties help prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
